reasons.persona_fit: Speaks directly to the 1–10 person business owner in a calm, practical voice; accurately incorporates Bareni's bounded scope, delivery model, and boundaries without any sales CTA.
reasons.clarity: Logically structured with an immediate main point, clearly distinguishing recurring operational drift from bounded workflow decisions.
reasons.actionability: Provides a practical, concrete exercise: isolate one repeating workflow, note weekly time spent, define the target outcome, and test against scope limits.
reasons.factual_grounding: Every claim aligns with the evidence; the 8–10 hours metric is explicitly qualified as a representative scenario, and core technical and operational boundaries are respected.
